# @adrienlcp packages

> Documentation and release history of the @adrienlcp packages: small, typed, dependency-free TypeScript packages, published on npm from github.com/AdrienLcp/packages.

Every page exists in English under /en and in French under /fr.

## Pages

- [Home](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en): every package and every export, searchable
- [@adrienlcp/biome-config](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/biome-config): Biome lint and format settings: single quotes, no semicolons, sorted keys and imports, no floating promises
- [@adrienlcp/browser](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/browser): Browser calls that hide a trap: a clipboard copy that works over plain HTTP, a wake lock that survives the tab going away, the reduced-motion preference
- [@adrienlcp/i18n](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/i18n): A typed i18n library in five files, with no dependencies, built on Intl
- [@adrienlcp/react-aria](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/react-aria): What every react-aria app of mine repeats: a className merge that follows the render state, and a Sass focus ring on data-focus-visible
- [@adrienlcp/react-router](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/react-router): react-aria links that navigate through react-router: a RouterProvider wired to useNavigate, external URLs left alone, NavigateOptions typed on every link
- [@adrienlcp/react](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/react): Generic React helpers: a context that names its missing provider, an element that finishes its exit transition before unmounting, and a class name join
- [@adrienlcp/result](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/result): A success-or-failure value with no exceptions and no nulls
- [@adrienlcp/safe-storage](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/safe-storage): localStorage that never throws: every read, write and removal returns a Result, and typed reads check what they find
- [@adrienlcp/styles](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/styles): A reset, a reduced-motion switch, default tokens, Sass mixins for self-hosted fonts, container queries, a breakpoint, focus rings, visually hidden text and a two-column spread, a fluid size in rem, and checks for WCAG contrast between colour tokens and for sizes the user's font size cannot reach
- [@adrienlcp/theme-preference](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/theme-preference): Light, dark or system theme with no flash on load, and a browser toolbar that follows the choice, and Sass mixins for a value per theme that light-dark() cannot carry
- [@adrienlcp/tsconfig](https://packages.adrienlcp.com/en/tsconfig): The strictest TypeScript settings, for a type-check-only project bundled by something else
